imagenes.prompt: A woven periwinkle shopping basket on a dark navy table, full of generic unbranded groceries: a round loaf of bread, apples, oranges, a bunch of bananas and a plain white milk bottle with no label. Abundant and appetising.

The same woven periwinkle shopping basket, same angle and lighting, now holding about a quarter less food: the bread, a few apples and the milk bottle remain, with visible empty space where the rest used to be. Slightly cooler, quieter mood.
